proof_body:
by
  intro A _ n
  constructor
  · intro f
    rw [← map_nsmul]
    simp
  · intro x hx
    have h0 : (zmultiplesHom A x) (n : ℤ) = 0 := by simpa [zmultiplesHom] using hx
    have hval : ∀ i : ℤ, (ZMod.lift n ⟨zmultiplesHom A x, h0⟩) (i : ZMod n) = i • x := fun i => by
      have := ZMod.lift_coe n (A := A) ⟨zmultiplesHom A x, h0⟩ i
      simpa using this
    refine ⟨ZMod.lift n ⟨zmultiplesHom A x, h0⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa using hval 1
    · intro g hg
      ext k
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := ZMod.intCast_surjective k
      rw [hval i, ← hg, ← map_zsmul]
      simp
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [AddCommGroup A] (n : ℕ), (∀ f : ZMod n →+ A, n • f 1 = 0) ∧ ∀ x : A, n • x = 0 → ∃! f : ZMod n →+ A, f 1 = x
